svg.title: arxstream — a jack-in-the-box with a stealer inside
svg.desc: A cardboard box covered in scrambled symbols, with two stickers: it stays shut on a Russian or Belarusian keyboard, and only opens if the clock ticks right. Turning its crank runs a six-step recipe, climbing from a hidden key through a card shuffle borrowed from RC4, a twist borrowed from AES, numbers borrowed from SHA-256, 512 stirs, and two unscrambling passes where the second ends with an addition instead of an XOR. At the top the lid opens and a grabber claw springs out holding a file and a browser cookie: the stealer payload.
